💡 Exchange Rate Information:

• Buy Rate: Rate at which you buy USD (USD → LBP)
• Sell Rate: Rate at which you sell USD (LBP → USD)
• You can fetch rates automatically from sp-today.com
• The spread between rates is your profit margin

💡 Invoice Information:

• Invoice number format can be customized
• Mandatory invoice requirements can be set

purchasing.info_text:
💡 Purchasing Information:

• Purchase order number format can be customized
• Auto-receiving of goods can be enabled
• Approval can be required before posting orders
• A default receiving location can be set

products_settings.info_text:
💡 Product Information:

• Stock can be tracked with low stock alerts
• Batches and serial numbers can be tracked
• Product code format can be customized
• Multiple images can be uploaded per product

customers_settings.info_text:
💡 Customer Information:

• Customer code format can be customized
• Credit limits can be set for customers
• Credit check can be enabled before sales
• Loyalty points and customer groups can be enabled

suppliers_settings.info_text:
💡 Supplier Information:

• Supplier code format can be customized
• Credit limits can be set for suppliers
• Supplier rating system can be enabled
• Tax number requirement can be enforced
